1B_Pradhan.scope: District controls repeated across 20 block PDFs; count each printed control once, not per block. Women overlap caste, and blank cells do not imply unreserved status.

1B_Upa-Pradhan.scope: District controls repeated across 20 block PDFs; count each printed control once, not per block. Women overlap caste, and blank cells do not imply unreserved status.

comparison_rules.category: Map parser category women to printed suffix W; caste SC/ST/BC compared unchanged.
comparison_rules.name: Collapse whitespace and remove whitespace immediately after a hyphen; preserve other spelling and case. Exact comparison also retained.
comparison_rules.ambiguous: Exclude five uncertain names from name agreement counts; keep their independently clear category labels.

limitations: The 336 units are shared row bands in two named columns, not 336 unique Gram Panchayats.
Blank cells give no affirmative reservation or unreserved status.
The printed district universe of 170 is repeated per block PDF; these positive lists do not enumerate all 170 GP offices.
Five names need adjudication from a higher resolution source; count agreement cannot resolve letter ambiguity.
The independent transcription was completed before parser comparison, but the reviewer had prior spot-check familiarity with some Purulia tables.
Parser comparisons describe the pinned cell_review.csv snapshot, not any later integrated corrections.
